newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada to auction C$2.4 billion bonds due 2007.
newsitem.headline: Canada to auction C$2.4 billion bonds due 2007.

text.p: The Government of Canada said it plans to auction on September 18 C$2.4 billion of bonds of an unspecified coupon maturing on June 1, 2007.
The bonds, which will be dated and delivered on October 1, pay interest on December 1 and June 1, the government said.
The Bank of Canada said it will acquire a minimum of C$240 million of the new bonds.
Proceeds of the issue will be used to redeem C$3.425 billion of government bonds maturing on October 1.
